reviews.review: I love this game.  I'm so sad they never got to make a sequel.

Space Marine is a third person action game set in the grim dark universe of Warhammer 40k. In the campaign, you play as Captain Titus of the Ultramarines and you'll be shooting, slashing and stomping your way through the enemies of the Imperium of Man.

As a game that's built around vanquishing your enemies, combat feels good. You can perform combos with your melee weapons to cut down or stun your enemies, setting them up for an execution. Executing a stunned enemy allows you to regain health, allowing you to get back into the fight quickly while making you look like a badass at the same time. Ranged weapons such as the Bolter, Heavy Bolter and Plasma Gun feel and sound powerful. One of my favourite weapons in the game is actually the Bolter as with controlled shots, its possible to snipe an enemy from afar. 

There is a certain weight to your armour as well, which is good considering that you are wearing Power Armour. Though I do wonder how do they roll at times but let's just chalk that one up to game logic.

Multiplayer is more of a class-based affair where you can customise your Space Marines/Chaos Space Marines in terms of their appearances and loadout. I didn't spend much time on the multiplayer component of the game outside of a few rounds of Exterminatus, the co-op Horde mode, which was added to the game for free. But if you feel like playing as Chaos instead, you'll need to pick up the Chaos Unleashed Map Pack.

That said, the DLCs are mainly catered for multiplayer (Versus and Exterminatus) so if you are looking only for the campaign experience, get the base game only during a sale as it may not be worth buying the game at full price if you are not looking to play the multiplayer modes.

Overall, would I say that Space Marine would blow your mind with an amazing storyline or groundbreaking gameplay mechanics? No. Despite its campaign being a little short, I thoroughly enjoyed playing it and it feels good to play as a Space Marine. In my opinion, Space Marine is actually one of the better Warhammer 40K titles out there despite its age. I would recommend it if you are looking for an action game set in the Warhammer 40K universe or if you are a new fan of 40K but you aren't too keen on the Dawn of War RTS series.

It's just a shame that we won't see a sequel to the game.
best space marine game until now... still waiting for part 2 in 2019...
The absolute best non-strategy Warhammer title ever made to date. And the one missing its sequel the most.

Hacking and slashing trough the enemies of mankind has never been this much fun. It has a lot of the same feel as Doom 2016, making you feel like a badass mowing down enemies.

For the Emperor!
